Violin Flex — Study Charts

1st Position Chart

Every note in 1st position: find the note on the staff, then read its string and finger — the circle colors match the fingers (open, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th).

Finding a Note's Finger

Stuck on a note? Find the nearest open string, then count the lines and spaces — add up from the string below, or subtract down from the one above. Both roads reach the same finger.

First Symbols

The first marks a young violinist meets — which way the bow moves, how to play each note, the left-hand & string signs, and how loud to play.

How Long Notes Last (4/4 Time)

Whole4 beats
Half2 beats
Quarter1 beat
Eighth½ beat
Advanced
Dotted Half3 beats
Dotted Quarter1½ beats
Sixteenth¼ beat

In 4/4 time a quarter note is 1 beat. A dot adds half again (a dotted half = 3 beats). Two eighths fill one beat; four sixteenths do too.
